name.en: The Antiquarium of The Palace Museum

description.en: Yangxing Hall, Leshou Hall and Yihexuan are arranged in order to the north of Ningshou Palace. Emperor Qianlong mainly lived here after becoming the Supreme Emperor, and Cixi also lived here after her 60th birthday.Among the three halls, Leshou Hall is the more gorgeous.The interior decoration of the hall is mostly covered with nanmu, red sandalwood, rosewood and other precious woods, and decorated with jade and enamel, making it appear elegant and luxurious.In the center of the north hall of the room is the Jade Mountain, a picture of Dayu's flood control. This is a huge jade sculpture hidden in the Forbidden City.The walls of the corridor outside the hall are inlaid with stone carvings of "Jingshengzhai Fa Tie", which are the ink marks of Emperor Qianlong's inscriptions on Dharma books and classic quotations.Currently, these three palaces have been turned into the Forbidden City Treasure Hall. The treasures in the collection are particularly rich, covering Buddhist supplies, ornaments, daily utensils and ornamental treasures. Most of these treasures are made of precious materials such as gold, silver, jade, jade, pearls and various gemstones, and are designed and manufactured by famous craftsmen from various places.Every effort was made to ingenuity and no expense was spared, and its craftsmanship represented the high level of the time.Among them, the 14-centimeter-high red coral lion and the 17.5-centimeter-high gold "Fengtian Treasure" seal are all rare treasures.
description.zh_CN: 养性殿、乐寿堂和颐和轩依次排列在宁寿宫以北，乾隆帝做太上皇以后主要居住在这里，慈禧六十大寿后也曾在这里居住。三殿中以乐寿堂较为华美。堂内装修多用楠木包以紫檀、花梨等贵重木材，并用玉石、珐琅装饰，显得雍容华贵。室内北厅中央摆放着大禹治水图玉山，这是故宫所藏巨大的一座玉雕。堂外走廊墙壁上镶嵌着“敬胜斋法帖”刻石，都是乾隆皇帝临写法书名帖与经典语录的墨迹。目前这三座宫殿被辟为了故宫珍宝馆，馆藏珍宝尤其丰富，涵盖佛教用品、饰品、日用器具和赏玩珍品等，这些珍宝大都选用金、银、玉、翠、珍珠及各种宝石等名贵材质，并征调各地有名匠师设计制造。竭尽巧思，不惜工本，其工艺代表了当时的高水平。其中高14厘米的红珊瑚狮子、17.5厘米高的金“奉天之宝”玺等，都是难得一见的珍品。

suggested_duration.zh_CN: 建议游览时间：1小时

description.en: The Museum of Chinese Nationalities is a theme park that displays the features of various ethnic groups in China.There are houses, temples, squares and other buildings imitating the characteristics of various ethnic groups in the park. You can feel the customs of various places while walking in the park.In addition, you can also visit exhibition halls displaying the styles of various ethnic groups, enjoy folk performances, and take photos in ethnic costumes.The Chinese Ethnic Museum covers a large area, about 1.2 kilometers long and 300 meters wide. It is divided into two gardens, the north and the south, with the Ethnic Garden Road in the middle.There are multiple entrances to the National Park, which can be entered from all directions. After entering, you can walk around the various ethnic areas and watch performances. It will take about half a day.There is a lake in each of the north and south gardens of the Museum of Chinese Nationalities, and buildings of various ethnic groups are built along the lake.On the south side, there are characteristic buildings of the Uyghur, Mosuo, Naxi, Bai, Zhuang and other ethnic groups. Each building has a cultural exhibition of its own ethnic group. The exhibition generally has pictures and texts combined with some ethnic costumes, cultural relics, etc., and you can visit them one by one.In the South Park, the Dali Three Pagodas, Sugong Pagoda, Sifang Street in Lijiang Ancient Town and other landmark buildings that imitate various places are particularly worth visiting and taking pictures.The area of ​​the North Garden is slightly larger than that of the South Garden. There are characteristic buildings of the Dai, Tibetan, Qiang, Lhoba, Miao, Hezhe and other ethnic groups. Among them, the Dai Garden is the largest. You can see Southeast Asian-style temples and houses, which are very unique. You can also take beautiful photos here.Like the North Park, there are also exhibition halls about the cultures of various ethnic groups. The South Park and the North Park combined have exactly 56 ethnic characteristics, and there are many of them.
description.zh_CN: 中华民族博物院是一处展示中华各民族风貌的主题公园。园内有仿造各民族特色的房屋、寺院、广场等建筑，在园中漫步即可感受各地风情。另外，还可以参观展示各民族风貌的展览馆，欣赏民俗表演，穿民族服装拍照留念。中华民族博物院的面积很大，长约有1.2公里，宽约有300米，分为南北两园，中间为民族园路。民族园有多个入口，从各个方向均可进入，进入后步行漫步游玩一个个民族区域，观看表演，大约半天时间为宜。中华民族博物院的南北两园内各有一座湖泊，各民族的建筑都沿湖而建。南侧有维吾尔族、摩梭族、纳西族、白族、壮族等多个民族的特色建筑，每座建筑内都有本民族的文化展览，展览一般有图片、文字结合一些民族特色的服饰、文物等，都可以一一参观。南园内，大理三塔、苏公塔、丽江古城四方街等模仿各地标志性的建筑尤其值得参观，拍照也十分不错。北园的面积比南园大一点，这里有傣族、藏族、羌族、珞巴族、苗族、赫哲族等多民族的特色建筑，其中以傣族园区的面积最 大，可以看到东南亚风格的寺庙和房屋，十分具有特色，还可以在这里拍摄美照。与北园一样，这里也有关于各民族文化的展览馆，南园北园加起来正好有56个民族的特色，一个不少。

description.en: Longmenjian is located on the northwest side of Yanjiatai, Qingshui Township, Mentougou District. The Longmenjian Scenic Area is dominated by the Grand Canyon, and there are dozens of unique landscapes in it.Longmen Stream is divided into East and West streams, each stretching for more than ten miles.Entering Longmenjian Canyon, you will see peaks on both sides facing each other. The spring water in the gorge is clear and blue, and there are also landscapes such as Jiangjun Stone, Yixiantian, Jianjian Peak, Black Dragon Pond, Tingyin Pavilion, and Tiantai.
description.zh_CN: 龙门涧位于门头沟区清水乡燕家台西北侧，龙门涧风景区以大峡谷为主景区，其中又有数十个各具特色的景观。龙门涧分为东西两涧，各绵延十余里。进入龙门涧峡谷，两侧山峰对峙，涧内泉水清澈碧透，还有将军石、一线天、试剑峰、黑龙潭、听音阁、祭天台等景观。

description.en: The Confucius Temple and the Imperial College Museum are composed of the Confucius Temple and the Imperial College, ancient buildings in Beijing. The two were closely adjacent to each other and had similar themes. They are now open to the public as the same scenic spot.The ticket office is next to the gate of the Confucius Temple. After purchasing the ticket, you enter the Confucius Temple and enter the Imperial College at the "Zhijing Gate" next to the stele pavilion.The Confucius Temple was built in the Yuan Dynasty and was the place where Confucius was worshiped during the Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties.The scale of the building is very large, and it takes about 1-2 hours to visit the Confucius Temple.There are three main points of concern when visiting the Confucius Temple, which you must pay attention to when visiting.The first is that the temple contains ancient Yuan Dynasty style buildings that are rare in Beijing and are very unique.The second is the numerous stone steles in the courtyard, including the inscriptions of Yuan Chonghuan, Lin Zexu, Li Hongzhang and others, the inscription steles on the roster of more than 50,000 Jinshi from the Yuan Dynasty to the end of the Qing Dynasty, and the forest of steles engraved with the Thirteen Confucian Classics. They are rich in content and very precious.The third is the traditional ritual music and dance "Dacheng Ritual Music" performance that is held several times a day in Chongsheng Temple, which expresses ancient traditional culture and art and is very exciting.In addition, the courtyard is antique, with many towering ancient trees, as well as memorial tablets to commemorate Confucius, cultural relics exhibitions, etc., which you can visit one by one.The Imperial College was a national institution of learning during the Ming and Qing dynasties, and it was also the place where emperors used to give lectures in person.Like the Confucius Temple, the architecture here is also antique. The ancient trees in the courtyard are towering, which makes it simple and beautiful. It is suitable for visiting and taking photos. Generally, the tour lasts about 1 hour.When visiting the Imperial College, you can pay attention to the buildings in the courtyard.Buildings such as Jixian Gate, Taixue Gate, and Glazed Archway are very distinctive, especially the colorful Glazed Archway, which is the iconic scenery of the Imperial College.Piyong Hall is the main body of the Imperial Academy. The outside of this building is surrounded by a circular pool, and the middle hall is square, which is very special.The Yilun Hall next to it is where ancient emperors gave lectures, and you can also visit it.There are also perennial exhibitions in the Imperial College such as the "Ancient Chinese Imperial Examination Exhibition" and the "Original Exhibition of the Imperial College". Tourists who are interested in the imperial examination system can visit it.
description.zh_CN: 孔庙和国子监博物馆是由北京市内的古建筑孔庙和国子监共同组成，两者本就紧紧相邻，而且主题比较相近，如今作为同一个景区对外开放。售票处在孔庙大门边，购票后进入孔庙，在碑亭旁的“持敬门”进入国子监游玩。孔庙始建于元朝，是元明清三朝祭祀孔子的地方。建筑规模很大，在孔庙内游览参观的时间大约1-2小时即可。游玩孔庙主要有三个关注点，游玩时一定要注意。第一是庙内有北京少有的元代风格古建筑，非常独特。第二是院内众多的石碑，其中有袁崇焕、林则徐、李鸿章等人的题字、元朝到清末的五万多名进士的名册的题名碑、刻满儒家十三经的碑林等，内容丰富，十分珍贵。第三便是崇圣祠院内每天会进行几次的传统礼乐舞蹈《大成礼乐》表演，表现了古代传统文化艺术，非常精彩。另外，院内古色古香，有很多参天的古树，还有关于祭奠孔子的牌位、文物展览等，都可以一一参观。国子监是明清时期的全国学府，也是过去皇帝亲自讲课的地方。同孔庙内一样，这里的建筑也是古色古香，院内古树参天，显得古朴漂亮，适合参观拍照，一般游览约1个小时即可。国子监游玩时，可以注意一下院内的建筑。集贤门、太学门、琉璃牌坊等建筑十分具有特色，尤其是琉璃牌坊色彩艳丽，是国子监的标志性景物。辟雍大殿是国子监内的主体，这座建筑外侧环绕圆形水池，中间殿宇则为方形，十分特别。旁边的彝伦堂就是古代皇帝讲课的地方，也可以好好参观一下。在国子监内还设有“中国古代科举展”和“国子监原状陈列展”等常年展览，对科举制度感兴趣的游客可以去参观。

description.en: The Water Cube (National Aquatics Center) is located on the north side of Beijing. The building is very unique. The exterior wall is composed of more than 3,000 irregular air pillow bubbles. From a distance, it looks like water molecules in the blue sea.The colorful lights are gorgeous at night, making it a great place to take photos of night scenes.When we visited the interior of the Water Cube and the sunlight filtered through, we discovered that there were not just one layer of bubbles forming the outer wall, but several layers. It was as if we had entered the fairy tale world of the mermaid princess inside the stacked bubbles.Many people want to poke bubbles when they see them. The exterior wall of the Water Cube is made up of so many air pillow bubbles, but there is only one place that can satisfy tourists' desire to know whether the bubbles are hard or soft, and that is the 170-square-meter "Bubble Bar" located in the southeast corner of the second floor. The special membrane structure that makes up the bubbles cannot be touched anywhere else.Please touch them gently in the "Bubble Bar" and take care of the Water Cube.If you want to have a close contact with cool water while swimming, the swimming pool and Water Cube water park on the first floor can satisfy you.Swim in the same swimming pool used by Olympic athletes and experience the feeling of being a sports star.You can't just go to the deep water area of ​​the swimming pool. The staff there are constantly walking back and forth to supervise you. You must have a deep water certificate. When entering the Water Cube, you can ask the staff to apply for a deep water certificate on the spot. After passing the assessment of swimming 200 meters and treading water for 30 seconds, you can pay an additional 20 yuan for the deep water certificate. Remember to bring a 1-inch photo.Swimming pool lockers are free.The Water Cube Water Park has amusement facilities such as Deep Sea Tornado (big horn), Overturning the River (tubular high-speed slide), Crazy Tsunami (artificial waves), etc. It is an exciting indoor water amusement park.The Water Cube Water Park locker requires additional rent and key tag deposit. No cash is required to use the key tag for consumption in the park. If necessary, you can top up at the service desk in advance, and the remaining balance will be refunded when you leave and return the key tag.Both the swimming pool and the Water Cube Water Park are air-conditioned and have constant temperatures all year round, so you can also play in winter.It should be noted that there is no time limit for visiting the Water Cube and the Water Cube Water Park, but there is a time limit for swimming. Each session is 2 hours including bathing and changing (an additional 30 minutes is required for the deep water certification test). Overtime is charged, 20 yuan for overtime within 30 minutes, 30 yuan for 30 to 60 minutes overtime, and 40 yuan for overtime of 60 minutes or more.When shooting night scenes, the main color of the Water Cube will be blue at night. The lights will change colors from time to time, matching the red lights of the Bird's Nest (National Stadium) next to it. It is like a "two heavens of ice and fire". You can come to shoot night scenes. The Water Cube turns off the lights around 21:30-10:00 in the evening. If you only want to see the night view without visiting the interior, don't come too late.In addition to hosting water events for tourists to visit and swim, there are also variety shows filmed at the Water Cube, such as the 2013 TV hit "Star Diving Cube".The Water Cube sells souvenirs related to the Olympics and the Water Cube itself. In the empty Mediterranean Sea between the Water Cube and the Bird's Nest, long strings of kites (many small kites connected in a string) are sold, which is very unique and can be played with flying kites.Water and food in the scenic area are relatively expensive.
description.zh_CN: 水立方（国家游泳中心）位于北京城区北侧，建筑非常奇特，外墙由3000多个不规则的气枕泡泡组成，远远望去像蓝色大海中的水分子。夜晚彩灯绚丽，更是拍夜景的好地方。参观进到水立方内部，阳光透进来，才发现构成外墙的泡泡不只一层，有好几层，仿佛进入了堆叠的泡泡内部，人鱼公主的童话世界。很多人看到泡泡都有戳一下的想法，水立方外墙由那么多气枕泡泡组成，却只有一个地方能满足游客想知道泡泡是硬还是软的想法，那就是位于二层东南角170平方米的“泡泡吧”，别的地方都是不能触摸构成泡泡的这种特殊膜结构的。在“泡泡吧”也请轻轻触摸它们，爱护水立方。游泳若想和清凉的水来个亲密接触，在一层的游泳馆和水立方嬉水乐园都能满足你。在奥运健将用过的泳池中游泳，也体验一把当体育明星的感觉。泳池的深水区不能随便去，边上工作人员一直来回走动看管很严，必须有深水证才行，进入水立方时可以向工作人员提出需要当场办理深水证，经过游泳200米和踩水30秒的考核后，另付20元深水证费用即可，记得还要带好1寸照片。游泳馆更衣柜是免费的。嬉水乐园水立方嬉水乐园内有深海龙卷风（大喇叭），翻江倒海（管状高速滑道），疯狂海啸（人工造浪）等游乐设施，是一个刺激的室内水上游乐园。水立方嬉水乐园更衣柜需另付租金及钥匙牌押金，乐园内消费刷钥匙牌不用现金，若有需要，可事先在服务台充值，余款离开还钥匙牌时会退的。无论是游泳馆还是水立方嬉水乐园都有空调，一年四季恒温，冬天也可以来玩。需要注意的是参观水立方和水立方嬉水乐园都没有时间限制，但是游泳有时间限制，每场2小时包括沐浴更衣（考深水证另加30分钟），超时要收费，超时30分钟以内收费20元，超时30至60分钟收费30元，超时60分钟以上收费40元。拍摄夜景晚上水立方会亮起主打色为蓝色的灯，不时变换色彩，与旁边鸟巢（国家体育场）的红色灯光相映，好像“冰火二重天”，可以来拍摄夜景，水立方差不多晚上21:30-10:00左右关灯，只看夜景不去内部参观的也别来太晚了。除了承办水上赛事，供游客参观、游泳，也有综艺节目在水立方拍摄，比如2013年电视上红极一时的《星跳水立方》。水立方有奥运相关、水立方自身相关的纪念品出售，水立方和鸟巢间的空地中海有卖长串风筝（很多小风筝连成一串），很别致，可以放风筝玩。景区内的水和食物是比较贵的。

description.en: The China Film Museum was built in 2005, the 100th anniversary of the birth of Chinese films. It is a film-themed museum.In addition to learning about the development history of Chinese films at various stages in the museum, it is also a cinema.Many classic old movies and current new movies can be watched here.The film museum exhibition area is mainly divided into six exhibition areas, namely the prologue hall, the invention of film, the birth and early development of Chinese films, Chinese films during the war, the creation and development of new Chinese films, and Chinese films in the new era of reform and opening up. In addition, there are special exhibitions of art films, children's films, scientific education films, translated films, news documentary films and other film types.After entering, you can visit them one by one, and it will take about 2 hours to visit them casually.What is displayed in several main exhibition halls is the development of Chinese films over the past one hundred years. The exhibition system is detailed and is an excellent place for tourists who are interested in films to learn more.The exhibition hall contains ancient film projection equipment, props, and restored sets of early films. The exhibits are very rich.Among the more precious ones are Zheng Zhengqiu’s study, a hand-cranked silent movie projector made in Germany, and the metal base plate of a photo taken by Ren Qingtai when he was 70 years old. Many of the exhibits have an iconic status in the history of Chinese film development, so you can take a closer look.In addition to viewing exhibitions, the museum is also a movie theater with the world's largest film giant screen.New movies that are currently available online will be played here, and generally the ticket price will be cheaper than regular movie theaters outside.In addition, there will be several classic old movies played here every day. The old movies are for public welfare and the ticket price is about 2 yuan. Interested friends can go and watch them.
description.zh_CN: 中国电影博物馆建于中国电影诞生100周年时的2005年，是以电影为主题的博物馆。除了在博物馆了解中国电影各个阶段的发展历史，这里同时也是一家电影院。很多经典的老电影和时下的新电影都能在这里观看。电影博物馆展区主要分为六个展区，分别为序厅、电影的发明、中国电影的诞生和早期发展、战争时期的中国电影、新中国电影的创建与发展、改革开放新时期的中国电影几大展厅，除此之外，还有美术电影、儿童电影、科学教育电影、译制电影、新闻纪录电影等多个电影种类的专题展出。进入后一一参观即可，草草参观一圈2小时左右。几个主要展厅内展示的便是一百余年来中国电影的发展脉络，展览系统详细，对于对电影感兴趣的游客来说是了解知识的绝妙之处。展馆内有古老的电影放映设备、道具，还有早期电影的布景复原等，展品非常丰富。其中比较珍贵的是郑正秋的书房、德国产手摇无声电影放映机、任庆泰70岁时拍摄的照片的金属底板等，很多展品都在中国电影发展的历史上具有标志性的地位，可以好好了解一下。除了观看展览外，博物馆同时也是一家电影院，拥有全球较大的胶片巨幅银幕。这里会播放时下在线的新电影，一般票价会比外面常规电影院便宜一些。另外，每天这里还会有几场经典老电影播放，老电影为公益性质，票价约2元左右，感兴趣的朋友可以前去观看。

description.en: Simatai Great Wall is the only section of the ancient Great Wall in my country that retains the original appearance of the Ming Great Wall.The Great Wall was built along a ridge that looks like a knife and axe. It is extremely steep and creates a variety of wall forms in this section of the Great Wall.There are 16 watchtowers in the eastern section of the Great Wall and 18 in the western section. Currently, only 10 watchtowers in the eastern section are open to the scenic spot (up to No. 10 East Watchtower).The original Great Wall attraction, Simatai Great Wall, is the latest Great Wall attraction to open in Beijing. It is located at the junction of Beijing and Hebei. Compared with Great Wall attractions such as Badaling, it is farther from the city. There are not many tourists coming to Simatai Great Wall, and there is no crowding phenomenon like Badaling Great Wall.In addition, the Simatai Great Wall was developed relatively late, thus avoiding the problem of over-repair. Compared with the Badaling Great Wall, it looks more original. As far as the eye can see, almost all of them are broken walls and ruins.Every autumn, the red leaves here also attract many tourists. Watching the red leaves all over the mountain on the ancient Great Wall is completely different from watching the red leaves in Xiangshan.The hiking route of Simatai Great Wall is relatively steep. It takes more than 1 kilometer to walk up the mountain from the foot of the mountain to the watchtower, which requires a certain amount of physical strength.There is a cableway at the foot of the Great Wall that can directly reach the "East 8th Floor" and "East 5th Floor". Tourists with limited physical strength can choose to take the cableway. The cableway costs 90 yuan for one way and 160 yuan for a round trip.
description.zh_CN: 司马台长城是我国唯一一段保留明长城原貌的古长城。长城沿着刀削斧劈似的山脊修建，险峻无比，也造就了这段长城的城墙形式多样性。长城东段有敌楼16座，西段有18座，景区目前只开放东段10座敌楼（东10号敌楼为止）。原汁原味的长城景点司马台长城是北京地区开放最晚的一处长城景点，地处北京和河北的交界处，和八达岭等长城景点相比，这里距离市区更远些，前来司马台长城的游客一直不多，没有八达岭长城那种人挤人的现象。此外，司马台长城开发时间较晚，避免了过度修缮的问题，与八达岭长城相比，这里更显得原汁原味，放眼望去，几乎都是断墙残垣。每年的秋季，这里的红叶也吸引不少游客前来，在古老的长城上，看满山的红叶，是与香山看红叶的感觉完全不一样。游玩路线参考司马台长城的登山路比较陡峭，从山脚下到敌楼处要走1公里多的上山路，需要一定的体力。在长城脚下有索道可以直接到达“东8楼”和“东5楼”附近，体力有限的游客可以选择乘坐，索道单程90元，往返160元。

description.en: Maoer Hutong starts from Nanluogu Lane in the east and ends at Di'anmenwai Street in the west.It is connected to Doujiao Hutong in the north and Dongbuyaqiao Hutong in the south.Because there were hat-making workshops here during the Qing Dynasty, it was called Maoer Hutong.You can admire many old Beijing courtyard houses in Maoer Hutong, and you can also feel the strong atmosphere of old Beijing life here.The existing intact courtyard houses here include: No. 5 Mao'er Hutong, No. 9 Mao'er Hutong (Keyuan), No. 11 Mao'er Hutong (Wenyu House), No. 13 Mao'er Hutong (former residence of Feng Guozhang), No. 21 Mao'er Hutong (site of Wenchang Palace in Zitong Temple), No. 37 Mao'er Hutong (former residence of Wanrong), No. 45 Mao'er Hutong (Prefect's Yamen of the Qing Dynasty), etc.The top of Mao'er Hutong intersects with Nanluogu Alley. A little past there is the famous Ju'er Hutong, and at the end is Yandai Hutong. So if you want to visit here and feel the atmosphere of old Beijing, Mao'er Hutong is a good choice.
description.zh_CN: 帽儿胡同东起南锣鼓巷，西至地安门外大街。北与豆角胡同相通，南与东不压桥胡同相通。因为清代的时候这里有制帽作坊，所以被称为帽儿胡同。在帽儿胡同可以欣赏到许多的老北京四合院，更可以感受到这里浓浓的老北京生活气息。这里现存完好的四合院有：帽儿胡同5号、帽儿胡同9号（可园）、帽儿胡同11号（文煜宅）、帽儿胡同13号（冯国璋故居）、帽儿胡同21号（梓潼庙文昌宫遗址）、帽儿胡同37号（婉容故居）、帽儿胡同45号（清提督衙门）等。帽儿胡同的顶端与南锣鼓巷相交，过去一点还有著名的菊儿胡同，末端是烟袋胡同，所以您要是想来此游览，感受老北京城的那种气息，帽儿胡同是不错的选择。

suggested_duration.zh_CN: 建议游览时间：1小时 - 2小时

description.en:
The China Aviation Museum is a large aviation museum.The museum houses more than 200 aircraft of more than 100 models, as well as more than 700 weapons and equipment samples such as surface-to-air missiles, air defense radars, anti-aircraft guns, and aerial cameras. It is a must-visit place for aviation and aerospace fans.The museum is divided into three parts: the comprehensive exhibition hall, the cave exhibition hall and the open-air exhibition hall.The open-air exhibition hall mainly displays various aircraft manufactured by countries around the world and other types of aircraft boutiques.The museum has displays such as "Engine Series Exhibition", "Treasure Exhibition", "Aerial Photography Equipment Exhibition", and "Life-Saving Protective Equipment Exhibition".There are more than 200 aircraft of more than 100 models in the museum, as well as more than 600 aviation exhibits such as ground-to-air and radar, many of which are exquisite.
The comprehensive exhibition hall is divided into three exhibition rooms.The first exhibition room displays various types of remote-controlled aircraft models and simulated aircraft models produced by the Aviation Museum; the second exhibition room displays precious gifts given to our country by various countries; and the third exhibition room displays exquisite military emblems, unit emblems and other gifts presented to the People's Air Force by foreign military delegations.
The exhibits in the Dongku Exhibition Hall are relatively rich. The exhibits range from ancient Chinese aviation inventions and discoveries to contemporary high-altitude and high-speed fighters, from modern imported foreign aircraft to domestically produced various types of aircraft. They are displayed on both sides of the large exhibition hall in historical order. There are Chujiao-5 aircraft that ended China's history of being unable to build aircraft, and China's self-developed fighter aircraft - J-12, etc., which are all eye-opening.
The aviation museum not only has aircraft displays, but also popular live-fire shooting and flight simulation games, but they all require additional charges.
description.zh_CN:
中国航空博物馆是一座大型航空博物馆。馆中收藏了100多种型号共200多架飞机，以及地空导弹、防空雷达、高炮、航空照相机等700多件武器装备样品，是航空航天迷的必游之地。博物馆分为综合展馆、洞库展厅和露天展厅三个部分。露天展厅主要陈列着世界各国制造的各种飞机和其它各类飞机精品。馆内设有“发动机系列展”、“珍品展”、“航空照相设备展”、“救生防护装备展”等陈列。馆内共有100多种型号的200多架飞机，还有地对空、雷达等航空展品共600余件，其中不乏精品。
综合展馆分三个展室。第一展室展出了航空博物馆自己制作的各型遥控飞机模型和仿真飞机模型；第二展室展出的是各国赠送给我国的珍贵礼物；第三展室展出的是外国军事代表团赠送给人民空军的精美军徽、部队徽等礼品。
洞库展厅的展品较为丰富，展品从中国古代的航空发明与发现到当代使用的高空高速歼击机，从近代引进国外的航空器到国产的各种类型飞机，依照历史的时序陈列于大型展厅两侧，有结束了中国不能造飞机历史的初教-5飞机，还有中国自行研制的歼击机——歼12等等，都让人眼界大开。
 航空博物馆不仅有飞行器的展示，还有受欢迎的实弹射击和飞行模拟游戏，不过都需要额外收费。

description.en: Beijing International Flower Port is located in Yang Town, Shunyi District, the northeastern suburbs of Beijing. It is located to the north of Baima Road. It has an overall planning of 4 square kilometers and is 39 kilometers away from the urban area. It is adjacent to Hanshiqiao Wetland to the south and the Beijing Olympic Water Sports Stadium to the west. It has a superior location and convenient transportation.Taking the 7th Flower Expo as a construction opportunity, Beijing International Flower Port focuses on the strategic positioning of "taking flowers as media, green as media, science as platform, and innovation as soul", organically integrating the flower industry with cultural tourism industry, and has been rated as "Beijing Shunyi National Agricultural Science and Technology Park" and a national 4A tourist attraction.In 2013, the "11th China Chrysanthemum Exhibition" was successfully held. At the same time, the "Beijing Tulip Cultural Festival" is held every spring, the "Beijing Rose Cultural Festival" and "Beijing Lily Cultural Festival" are held in the summer, and the "Beijing Chrysanthemum Cultural Festival" is held in the autumn.Up to now, Flower Port has held more than 30 flower events.The Beijing International Flower Port Scenic Spot has a unique design concept and sophisticated garden landscape architecture. The construction concept of "ecology, technology, conservation, intensiveness, and sustainable development" has been integrated into the construction. The landscape and ecological flowers are cleverly combined to form a comprehensive industrial park that focuses on the production, research and development, display, and trade of flowers, and also has flower cultural exchange, tourism and leisure functions.The Beijing International Flower Port scenic area and supporting facilities are divided into four functional areas: open-air flower display area, facility production area, R&D supporting service area, and urban agricultural sightseeing area.The Flower Port Scenic Area includes more than ten scenic spots including the "Sakura Avenue" where you can dance with cherry blossoms, the rolling "Sea of ​​Flowers", the "Butterfly World" where butterflies dance among the flowers, the beautiful and dreamy "Huan Hua Lake", and the "Valley of Lovers" where destined people hold hands and enjoy the river of love. Each scenic spot cleverly combines flowers from all over the world with international planning concepts, each with its own ingenuity, unique and delicate techniques, and artificial miracles in nature.When you are in the flower port, "everything you see is the shadow of flowers, and the butterflies are dancing gracefully."Beijing International Flower Port is welcoming guests and friends from all over the world with its beautiful appearance.
description.zh_CN: 北京国际鲜花港坐落在北京市东北郊的顺义区杨镇，位于白马路以北，总体规划4平方公里，距市区39公里，南与汉石桥湿地相邻，西与北京奥运水上项目赛场相接，位置优越，交通便捷。北京国际鲜花港以第七届花卉博览会为建设契机，聚焦“以花为媒、以绿为介、以科为台、以创为魂”的战略定位，将花卉产业与文旅产业有机融合，被评为“北京顺义国家农业科技园区”和国家4A级旅游景区。2013年成功举办了“第十一届中国菊花展览会”，同时每年春季举办“北京郁金香文化节”，夏季举办“北京月季文化节”、“北京百合文化节”、秋季举办“北京菊花文化节”。截止目前，鲜花港共举办了30余次花事盛会。北京国际鲜花港景区设计构思独特，园林景观建筑考究，建设中融入了“生态、科技、节约、集约、可持续发展”的建设理念，将景观、生态花卉巧妙的结合，形成了以花卉的生产、研发、展示、交易为主，兼具花卉文化交流、旅游休闲功能的综合性产业园区。北京国际鲜花港景区及配套设施构成分为露天花卉展示区、设施生产区、研发配套服务区、都市农业观光区四大功能区。鲜花港景区包括与樱花共舞的“樱花大道”、连绵起伏的“大地花海”、花间蝶舞的“蝴蝶大世界”、灵秀梦幻的“幻花湖”、有缘人牵手共沐爱河的“情人谷”等是十余个景点，各景点将天下花卉和国际化的规划理念巧妙结合，各具匠心，手法独特细腻，于自然之中见人工奇迹。置身鲜花港，“入目皆花影，蝶自舞翩翩”。北京国际鲜花港正以她靓丽的身姿，张开怀抱迎接五洲宾朋。

description.en: The China Paleontology Museum is a museum that systematically introduces the origin and phylogeny of vertebrates.It is a special natural science museum that uses paleontological fossils as a carrier to systematically popularize knowledge about paleontology, paleoecology, paleoanthropology and evolution.The basic display in the museum consists of four parts: "Dinosaur World (Electronic Machinery Simulation)", "Ancient Fish Hall", "Ancient Reptiles Hall" and "Mammals Hall". Through physical objects and other display means, the audience is systematically introduced to the origin and evolutionary history of prehistoric vertebrates, and displays ancient vertebrate fossils preserved in marine and continental strata deposited in various periods in China, as well as research results in this scientific field.The precious exhibits on display in the Paleozoological Hall include specimens of Latimei fish, known as "living fossils", and exquisite fossils such as the majestic Yellow River Elephant skeleton, which is included in primary school textbooks.Recently, the museum has added precious exhibits that have caused a sensation in the world, including hairy dinosaurs, bird fossils such as Confucius Birds, and the world's first pterosaur embryo.
description.zh_CN: 中国古动物馆是一座系统介绍脊椎动物起源和系统发育的博物馆。它是以古生物化石为载体，系统普及古生物学、古生态学、古人类学及进化论知识的自然科学类专题博物馆。馆内基本陈列由“恐龙世界(电子机械模拟)”、“古鱼类馆”、“古爬行动物馆”、“哺乳动物馆”等四部分组成，通过实物和其它展示手段，向观众系统地介绍了史前脊椎动物的起源及其进化历史，展示中国在各个时期沉积的海陆相地层中保存的古脊椎动物化石及在这一科学领域中的研究成果。古动物馆展出的珍贵展品中包括被称为“活化石”的拉蒂迈鱼标本，以及被编入小学课本的威严耸立的黄河象骨架等精品化石。较近馆内又增添了带毛恐龙、孔子鸟等鸟类化石以及世界首枚翼龙胚胎等在世界上引起轰动的珍贵展品。

description.en: Beijing Wenyu River Park is located in the northeastern part of Beijing's central city, at the junction of Chaoyang, Shunyi and Changping districts, at the intersection of Wenyu River and Qinghe River, and upstream of the city's sub-center. With a planned area of ​​30 square kilometers, it is the largest "green lung" in Beijing.It integrates ecological conservation, habitat restoration, flood storage and detention functions, and takes into account diverse functions such as culture, leisure, and sports, forming a large-scale ecological space with interwoven blue and green, interdependent forests and water, biodiversity, and ecological benefits for the people, striving to become the "golden business card" of the capital's ecological civilization construction.The Beijing Wenyu River Park Demonstration Area covers an area of ​​2.04 square kilometers. It is the largest "green lung" in Beijing. It integrates ecological conservation, habitat restoration, flood storage and detention functions, and takes into account various functions such as culture, leisure, and sports, forming a large-scale environment where blue and green are intertwined, forests and water are interdependent, biodiversity is diverse, and ecology benefits the people.ecological space, and strive to create a “golden business card” for the capital’s ecological civilization construction.The Beijing Wenyu River Park Demonstration Area covers an area of 2.04 square kilometers. It was the first to start construction in early 2019, and strives to embody the demonstration in six major aspects: forest, water, environment, intelligence, garden, and soil.The spatial planning is "one axis, one vein, five areas". Based on the forest, field and water features, it is divided into five areas: Forest Valley Area, Terrace Wet Area, Huaxi Jintian Area, Vibrant East Lake Area and Adventure Forest Area; Park DistributionThere are ten scenic spots including Huaxi Jintian, Yuhu Lake, Meandering River, waterfalls and emerald greens, Jianjia Zhaoshui, Yunshang Terraces, Pine Cloud Canopy, Sunshine Beach, Tsutaya House and Linglong Moon Viewing.Huaxi Jintian Huaxi Jintian is one of the 10 major attractions in Wenyu River Park in Beijing. It is located in the East Park of the park.The total area of Huaxi Jintian is about 8 hectares. It is composed of criss-crossing colorful flower fields, twists and turns of Dongguanyun crops and antique flower field wharf, which is spectacular.The path is winding and interesting, and the fruits and vegetables are of different heights, as ifA "garden outside the world".The vegetables here are fragrant and full of fruits. It is a fashionable place to check in in the park, and it is also a scene not to be missed during autumn outings in the suburbs of Beijing.Yuhu Yuhu is located in the East Park of Wenyu River Park in Beijing and is one of the top ten attractions in the park.The total area of Yuhu Lake is about 21 hectares, which can be adjusted during flood season and enjoyed during normal times.The park surrounds the lake to create "a waterfront tour line, a willow bank embankment, and multiple waterfront nodes", a considerable and travelable dynamic leisure attraction, making it a tourist attraction that allows tourists to enjoy nature and get close to each other.A must-visit place for water appreciation.On the tree-lined boulevard by the Jade Lake, the elderly are strolling leisurely, parents are leading their children to spend family time together, and couples are walking here to enjoy the romantic and leisure atmosphere.The lakeside buildings are scenic spots and convenient signs; the garden roads are covered with trees, and the scenery is different as you walk; the waterfront loop is pleasant in scale, quiet and comfortable; the overall shape is an ecological scenic spot with clear water, green shores, pleasant scenery, diverse vitality, and enjoyment of nature.Meandering River Meandering River is one of the top ten attractions in Wenyu River Park in Beijing.Water control and gardening restore a river in nature. It is a river that carries multiple functions such as water purification, riverside recreation, and tent camps.The Meandering River highlights the harmony and co-prosperity between man and nature.The twists and turns of the meandering river not only enrich the tourists' experience, increase spatial changes, but also create more water and land ecological interfaces, revitalizing the entire eastern forest habitat system.Today, there are flocks of geese and ducks in the Quhe River, and birds such as egrets, herons, and magpies are drinking water in the river, which is full of life..Strolling along the Meandering River, you will see rippling blue waves and green trees on both sides. It is like "people swimming in the middle of a painting", and you can enjoy the vivid pictures of the harmonious coexistence between man and nature."Falling waterfalls and emerald greens surround Wenyu and the picturesque scenery looks forward to your visit." Flying waterfalls and emerald greens are one of the top ten scenic spots in Wenyu River Park in Beijing. They are also the source of living water and unique water landscape in the demonstration area, and a refreshing place to check in in the hot summer.The waterfall is a multiple landscape composed of a large waterfall and multiple small waterfalls. The large waterfall is 7 meters long.The height difference and waterfall landscape combine vertically and horizontally with rich layers.There is a trestle under the waterfall that can be viewed up close. Visitors here can feel the splashing water, hear the gurgling water, and the mist lingering, just like a fairyland, giving them a refreshing and joyful feeling.Above the large waterfall are tiers of small waterfalls, with lush forests behind it, large trees on the islands in the water, and koi carps roaming freely underwater. It's like a secret forest, cool and comfortable.Standing on the top of the waterfall and looking north, the water of the waterfall andThe wetland water in the park is connected together, with layers upon layers, rising and falling, forming a large-scale ecological space where forests and water thrive together, and blue and green interweave.The best viewing times for the waterfall are from 9:00 to 11:00 in the morning and from 4:00 to 6:00 in the afternoon.Yunshang Terraces Yunshang Terraces are more than 20 meters high. They are a high-lying scenic spot in the Wenyu River Park Demonstration Area in Beijing. The terraces are layered on top of each other. Walking along the field path, it feels like climbing a ladder into the clouds.Yunshang terraced fields can provide tourists with the experience of traditional farming.It is an industrial farming site and has important ecological and educational significance.There is an observation deck at the commanding heights of the terraces, called "Wangyuntai", which is a beautiful symbol of hard work and harvest.Climbing up to the Wangyuntai, you can not only have a panoramic view of the terraced fields, but also enjoy the natural scenery and city scenery from a distance.Looking to the east, Wenyu River Park is full of mountains, rivers, forests, fields, lakes and grasses, and it is a wonderful sight.Looking to the west, the Qinghe River with interdependent forests and water flows through it; looking to the south, there are waterfalls and greenery in the near distance, and Wangjing SOHO and Tiantongyuan in the distance.Beautiful view of the city.Looking to the north, you can see the rolling Beishan Mountain and the vibrant Future Science and Technology City at the foot of the Beishan Mountain, which stands between the sky and the earth. It can be said that the scenery is 360 degrees, and the scenery is infinite.Sunshine Beach Sunshine Beach is the golden business card of Wenyu River Park in Beijing, and it is also a beach recreation place.Sunshine Beach, Fengming Terrace and Feifeng Valley are connected in series to form a natural landscape axis, creating a life-nurturing landscape picture of Fengming Gaogang, Fengfei Flower Valley and Sunshine Beach, which is lifelike and fascinating.Think.The sunny beach covers an area of more than 3,000 square meters, and the coastline extends for hundreds of meters.With the west mountain at its back and Qinhu Lake in the east, it has the poetic experience of "facing the sea and blooming flowers in spring".It is the dawn and dusk, a peaceful place!Qinhu Lake has wide open waters and diverse scenery. In spring and summer, the breeze is rippling, and the water surface is calm and cool. In autumn, the vegetation is yellowish and the water is shimmering. In winter, it is frosty and pure, just like a mirror looking upside down between heaven and earth.Sunshine Beach is a place to experience the beautiful scenery of Qinhu Lake up close and in multiple time and space.playSand, water, and lake viewing are all places for leisure and entertainment.Linglong Moon Viewing Walking north along Qinhu Lake, you can encounter a quiet, peaceful and relaxing place. This is the Linglong Moon Viewing Attraction."Linglong Moon Viewing" is one of the core attractions in the Wenyu River Park Demonstration Area in Beijing. It is an exquisite island on the north bank of Qinhu Lake and serves as a bridge connecting the forest valley area and the wetland landscape area.Linglong Moon View is surrounded by mysterious mountains and forests in the north and open water in the south. Because of its island shape, it is like the moon and jade.It is exquisite and exquisite, open on three sides, suitable for admiring the moon, so it is named "Linglong Moon Viewing"."Linglong Moon Viewing" adapts to local conditions and is laid out according to the situation, carrying forward the advantages of classical gardens. The spatial levels are gradual, giving visitors a "feeling of going back and forth."The original appearance of the site consisted of high piles of dregs with uneven potholes, which easily formed pools of water during the rainy season.Make use of pits and ponds to create landscape pools, stack volcanic rocks in the pools to purify the water quality, and build islands in the water, forming "an island in a lake, a pool in an island, and an island in a pool"layout.As you approach this mysterious island, you will see a view corridor thousands of meters long to the south. Looking across the lake, you can clearly see the wetland Tsutaya several hundred meters away. Looking further away, you can vaguely see the city skyline composed of buildings such as the "China Zun" and Wangjing SOHO.Tsutaya Tsutaya is one of the commanding heights of the Western Garden. It is an ecological bird-watching tower with a novel and refined architectural form. It provides tourists with a place to climb the tower and look into the distance. Here, they can enjoy bird watching, lake viewing, garden viewing, and truly experience the "setting clouds"Flying together with the solitary swans, the autumn water and the sky are the same color." In the future, through the conservation of the wetland water system, a large number of migratory birds will settle in the reed swamps. Standing on the Tsutaya House, you can watch the spectacular bird habitat scene. By then, the Tsutaya House will also inheritIt serves more and more functions such as leisure and nature education, allowing citizens to enjoy the natural beauty from multiple angles and in all directions.Wuliu Guan Lake is the core attraction in the east area of the park.There is nothing wrong with him, and he looks green."The south side of Yuhu Lake is lined with green trees and rows of willows. On the flat and wide viewing platform with a wide view, you can have a panoramic view of the beautiful scenery of Yuhu Lake. The green trees on the lakeside avenue and the clear lake water complement each other, showing that the willows are alive because of the lake and the lake is alive because of the willows.The beautiful scenery together constitutes the pleasant scenery of the lakeside loop.The Wuliu Lake Viewing Scenic Spot is an important part of the park's creation of "a waterfront tour line, a willow bank embankment, and multiple waterfront nodes" around Yuhu Lake.Dianfanghua is located near Gate 3 of the East Park of the Chaoyang Demonstration Area of Wenyu River Park in Beijing. It is an ecological space with symbiotic forests and grasses, dense reeds, and winding paths.Paths for pedestrians, grassland and reeds combine to create a charming scenery here.Behind the reeds is a wide, soft lawn, which is like a green carpet covering the ground. This is one of the areas planned for tent camping in the park.The beauty of the meadow at night is a unique scene, tourists can look up at the stars here and feel the unique charm of nature.Hanliugou Hanliugou is located near Langkun Zizai Bookstore in Xiyuan, Chaoyang Demonstration Area, Wenyu River Park, Beijing. It is a beautiful, peaceful and peaceful lawn area.There are rows of willow trees on both sides of the lawn like guards, protecting the lawn from wind and rain and providing shade and sun.With its beautiful scenery and peaceful atmosphere, this place has become a must-stop for many painters and photographers who come to sketch and take pictures.As a park planningIn the camping area, visitors can set up tents here, enjoy sitting on the lawn, surrounded by green trees, looking at the unique scenery of the fountain and Langkun Bookstore in the distance, and enjoy spending time with their families.Ecological Cultural Center Beijing Wenyuhe Park Xiyuan Ecological Cultural Center is located on the bank of Qinhu Lake and is surrounded by many major attractions in the park.There is a beautiful lawn near the Ecological Cultural Center. This lawn is not only a camping area planned by the park, but also a venue for hosting large-scale events such as the "Wheat Field Music Festival"Main venue.Visitors can enjoy the park's combination of unrestrainedness and gentleness, agility and dignity.Strolling along the lakeside, looking at Tsutaya and waterfalls from a distance, and taking in the core landscape of the park, the beautiful scenery, abundant vitality, and vigorous vitality will surely make tourists linger and make their trip worthwhile.Langkun Zizai Bookstore Langkun Zizai Bookstore is located in the West Park of Chaoyang Demonstration Area of Wenyu River Park in Beijing. It adheres to the concept of "nature is a good school and the park is an interesting classroom" and aims to provide students with a better environment for people living in the city.Children in the hustle and bustle of the city create a vibrant environment for cognitive nature, stimulating children's curiosity and interest in nature.The Chaoyang Demonstration Area of Wenyu River Park in Beijing has "flowers in three seasons and green in four seasons". There are hundreds of plants distributed there, making it the best choice for children to get close to nature.As a place for natural science education, Langkun Zizai Bookstore has a wealth of books covering different categories such as biological illustrations, natural interpretations, and naturalists. It is also equipped with bird watching and insect watching facilities., painting and other equipment, allowing children to feel the charm of nature in a more vivid, three-dimensional and all-round way and explore the mysteries of various plants.Langkun Zizai Bookstore business hours: Wednesday to Sunday 10:00-18:00 (closed on Mondays and Tuesdays) Wangshan Pavilion Wangshan Pavilion is located at the east end of the East Park of the Wenyu River Park Demonstration Zone in Beijing. It is also the commanding height of the entire East Park, providing a place for tourists to climb up and look into the distance.When visitors climb up the pavilion and look into the distance, they can not only enjoy the beautiful scenery of the East GardenWith a panoramic view, you can also enjoy the beautiful scenery of mountains, rivers, nature and city from a distance.Looking to the south, you can see the dense forest of the park full of vitality in the distance, and the beautiful views of Wangjing SOHO, China Zun and other cities in the distance; looking to the west, you can have a panoramic view of the East Garden with lush vegetation, roads and buildings.Wangshan Pavilion is the best place to enjoy the sunset in the park.At sunset, the afterglow of the setting sun scatters over the peaceful and peaceful park, adding a poetic touch to the already beautiful natural landscape.

北京温榆河公园位于北京市中心城区东北部，朝阳、顺义、昌平三区交界地区，温榆河清河两河交汇之处，城市副中心上游，规划范围30平方公里，是北京大的“绿肺”。集生态涵养、生境修复、蓄滞洪功能于一体，兼顾文化、休闲、体育等多样功能，形成蓝绿交织、林水相依、生物多样、生态惠民的大尺度生态空间，努力打造成为首都生态文明建设“金名片”。北京温榆河公园示范区占地2.04平方公里，于2019年初率先启动建设，并着力从林、水、境、智、园、土六大方面体现示范性。空间规划“一轴、...北京温榆河公园位于北京市中心城区东北部，朝阳、顺义、昌平三区交界地区，温榆河清河两河交汇之处，城市副中心上游，规划范围30平方公里，是北京大的“绿肺”。集生态涵养、生境修复、蓄滞洪功能于一体，兼顾文化、休闲、体育等多样功能，形成蓝绿交织、林水相依、生物多样、生态惠民的大尺度生态空间，努力打造成为首都生态文明建设“金名片”。北京温榆河公园示范区占地2.04平方公里，于2019年初率先启动建设，并着力从林、水、境、智、园、土六大方面体现示范性。空间规划“一轴、一脉、五区”，根据林田水风貌，划分为森林乐谷区、梯田湿地区、花溪锦田区、活力东湖区和探险森林区等五个区域；园区分布着花溪锦田、玉湖、曲河、飞瀑叠翠、蒹葭照水、芸上梯田、松云华盖、阳光沙滩、茑屋、玲珑望月十大景点。花溪锦田花溪锦田是北京温榆河公园10大景点之一，位于园区的东园。花溪锦田总面积约8公顷，由纵横交错的多彩花田、曲曲折折的东囿云稼和古色古香的花田码头共同组成，蔚然壮观。路径曲折有趣，蔬果高矮有致，仿佛一处“世外花园”。这里蔬菜🥦飘香、硕果累累，是公园的时尚打卡之地，也是北京市郊秋游不容错过的景色。玉湖玉湖位于北京温榆河公园东园，是园区十大景点之一。玉湖总面积约21公顷，汛期调蓄、平时赏景。园区围湖打造形成“一条滨水游线、一条柳岸长堤、多个滨水节点”的可观、可游的活力休闲景点，成为游客乐享自然、亲水赏景的必游之地。玉湖畔的林荫道，老人在悠闲的漫步，父母领着小孩共同度过亲子时光，情侣在此散步，享受浪漫、休闲的氛围。湖畔建筑点景，便捷标志；园路林荫覆盖，步移景异；滨水环线尺度宜人，恬静舒适；整体塑造水清岸绿、景色宜人、活力多元、乐享自然的生态景区。曲河曲河是北京温榆河公园的十大景点之一，是通过治水造园，恢复自然界中的一条河流，是承载水质净化，沿河游玩、帐篷营地等多种功能的河流。曲河，突出展现了人与自然的和谐共荣。曲河之曲折蜿蜒，不仅丰富了游客的体验，增加了空间的变化，更创造了更多的水陆生态界面，盘活了整个东部森林的生境系统。如今，曲河中雁鸭成群，白鹭、苍鹭、喜鹊等鸟类在河中汲水，生机盎然。沿曲河漫步，河水碧波荡漾，两岸林木苍翠，如“人在画中游”，遍赏人与自然和谐共生的生动画面。飞瀑叠翠“飞瀑叠翠环温榆风景如画盼君来”，飞瀑叠翠是北京温榆河公园十大景点之一，更是示范区的活水之源与独具特色的水景观，炎炎夏日的清凉打卡之地。飞瀑叠翠是由一层大瀑布和多层小叠瀑组合的多重景观，大瀑布有7米高差，瀑布景观纵横结合，层次丰富。瀑布下设置可近距离观赏的栈桥，游人到此可感受到飞溅的水花，听到潺潺的流水声，薄雾缭绕，犹如仙境，别有一番神清气爽，心情愉悦的感受。大瀑布上面是层层叠叠的小瀑布，后面密林郁郁葱葱，水中岛屿大树林立，水底锦鲤自由自在，如森林秘境，清凉舒适。站在叠瀑之顶往北望，瀑布之水与园区湿地之水连成一片，层层叠叠，起起伏伏，形成林水共荣，蓝绿交织的大尺度生态空间。瀑布的佳观赏时间为每天早上9:00～11:00与下午4:00～6:00。芸上梯田芸上梯田高20余米，是北京温榆河公园示范区地势高的景点，梯田层层叠叠，沿田间小路步行而上，好似登梯入云。芸上梯田可以为游客提供体验传统农业耕种场地，具备重要的生态教育意义。梯田制高点有一处观景台，名为“望芸台”，是耕耘与收获的美好寓意。登上望芸台，不仅可将梯田美景尽收眼底，还可以远观山水自然和城市美景。往东望，温榆河公园山水林田湖草共荣，气象万千。往西望，林水相依的清河穿流而过，往南望，近处是飞瀑叠翠，远处是望京SOHO、天通苑等城市美景。往北望连绵起伏的北山和北山下生机活力的未来科技城矗立天地之间，可谓360度，风光无限。阳光沙滩阳光沙滩是北京温榆河公园的金名片，更是一片沙滩游憩场所。阳光沙滩与凤鸣台、飞凤谷串联成一个整体，形成一条自然的景观轴线，营造出凤鸣高岗，凤飞花谷，阳光沙滩三段孕育生命的景观画面，栩栩如生，令人遐想。阳光沙滩面积约三千多平米，岸线延展数百米。其背依西山，东面沁湖，有“面朝大海、春暖花开”的诗意体验。正是晨曦暮霭，一片祥和之地！沁湖水域开阔，景致多样，春夏微风荡漾，水面波澜不惊，甚是清凉；秋季草木微黄，水光潋滟，冬季冰霜玉洁，宛若明镜倒扣天地之间。阳光沙滩是近距离、多时空体验沁湖美景的地点。玩沙、亲水、观湖都是休闲娱乐的之处。玲珑望月沿着沁湖信步向北走，可邂逅一个幽静祥和、休闲放松的好去处，这里就是玲珑望月景点。“玲珑望月”是北京温榆河公园示范区的核心景点之一，是沁湖北岸的一座玲珑小岛，是连接森林乐谷区和湿地景观区的桥梁纽带。玲珑望月北靠幽秘的山林，南依开阔的水面，因其岛型如月似玉，小巧玲珑，三面开阔，适赏月，故得名“玲珑望月”。“玲珑望月”因地制宜，依势布局，发扬古典园林的优点，空间上层次渐进，给游客“回环往复之感”。场地原貌是高堆的渣土，坑洼不平，雨季易形成积水坑塘。对坑塘进行利用，营造景观水池，水池中叠置火山岩，净化水质，并在水中筑岛，形成了“湖中有岛、岛中有池、池中复岛”的布局。走近这座神秘的岛屿，向南是长达数千米的视廊，视线掠过湖面，可以清晰看到数百米外的湿地茑屋，再远观，隐约可见“中国尊”、望京SOHO等建筑组成的城市天际线。茑屋茑屋为西园制高点之一，是一处生态观鸟塔，建筑形式新颖脱俗，为游客提供了登塔远望的场所，在这里可以尽情观鸟、观湖、观园，真正体验“落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色”的静怡与洒脱。未来通过湿地水系涵养，大量迁徙鸟类将在芦苇荡安家落户，站在茑屋上可以观看到壮观的鸟类栖息场景，届时茑屋也将承担越来越多的休闲及自然教育等功能，使市民能够多角度、全方位享受到自然美景。五柳观湖五柳观湖是公园东区的核心景点。“五柳”取意“五柳柴桑宅，三杨白下亭。往来无一事，长得见青青。”玉湖的南侧绿树成荫，杨柳成排。在视野开阔、平坦宽广的观景台上，玉湖美景尽收眼底，湖畔林荫道的绿树与清澈的湖水交相辉映，呈现柳因湖而活，湖因柳而灵的一派美好景象，共同构成了滨湖环线宜人的景色。五柳观湖景点是园区围绕玉湖打造“一条滨水游线、一条柳岸长堤、多个滨水节点”的重要组成部分。草甸芳华草甸芳华位于北京温榆河公园朝阳示范区东园3号门附近，是一处林草共生，芦苇茂密，曲径通幽的生态空间。供行人行走的小路与草地、芦苇丛结合，共同构成了此处迷人的景色。在芦苇丛后，是一片广扩、柔软的草坪，如同为大地铺上了一层绿色的地毯，此处是公园规划用于帐篷露营活动的区域之一。夜晚的草甸芳华别有一番景象，游客可在此仰望星空，感受大自然独特的魅力。旱柳沟旱柳沟位于北京温榆河公园朝阳示范区西园郎昆自在书屋附近，是一片风景优美、安宁祥和的草坪区域。草坪两旁有成排的柳树如同守卫，为草坪遮风挡雨、僻阴遮阳。此处凭借其优美的风景、安宁的氛围，成为众多前来写生取景的画家与摄影师的必经之处。作为园区规划的露营区域，游客可在此处搭建帐篷，享受坐拥草坪，被绿树环绕，远观喷泉与郎昆书屋的独特风景，享受与家人共度的惬意时光。生态文化中心北京温榆河公园西园生态文化中心位于沁湖湖畔，被公园多个主要景点环绕。生态文化中心附近有一片秀美的草坪，此处草坪不仅是公园规划的露营区，也是举办“麦田音乐节”等大型活动的主场地。游客可在此尽情感受公园的奔放与温婉、灵动与端庄的结合。漫步湖畔，远观茑屋与瀑布，一览园区的核心景观，秀丽的风光、盎然的生机、蓬勃的活力定会让游客流连忘返，不虚此行。朗昆自在书屋朗昆自在书屋位于北京温榆河公园朝阳示范区西园，秉持“自然是好的学校，公园是趣的课堂”这一理念，旨在为生活在城市喧嚣中的孩子们创造一个充满活力的认知自然的环境，激发孩子们对大自然的好奇与兴趣。北京温榆河公园朝阳示范区“三季有花，四季有绿”，分布着上百种植物，是孩子们亲近自然的不二之选。作为一个自然科普教育场所，朗昆自在书屋拥有丰富的书籍，涵盖生物图鉴、自然演绎、博物学家等不同类别，并且配备了观鸟、观虫、画画等设备，让孩子们更加生动、立体、全方位的感受自然的魅力，探索各类植物的奥秘。朗昆自在书屋营业时间：周三至周日10：00-18：00（周一、周二不营业）望山阁望山阁是位于北京温榆河公园示范区东园的东端，也是整个东园的制高点，为前来观光的游客提供的登高望远之处。游客登亭远眺，不仅可将东园美景尽收眼底，还可远观山水自然和城市美景。往南望，近处是生机盎然的公园密林，远处是望京SOHO、中国尊等城市美景；向西望去，则可将植被郁郁葱葱、道路与建筑错落有致的东园景色尽收眼底。望山阁更是园区欣赏日落的之所。日落时分，夕阳的余晖散在安宁祥和的公园之上，更为本就美不胜收的自然景观增添了诗情画意。

description.en: Beijing Garden Expo is the venue for the 9th China International Garden Expo. It is located in the green ecological development belt of Yongding River in Fengtai District, southwest of Beijing. It is adjacent to the new right embankment of Yongding River in the east, Yingshan Park in the west, Meishikou Road in the south and Lianshi West Road in the north. It relies on the Yongding River and echoes the Marco Polo Bridge. It has a rich historical and cultural atmosphere, varied terrain, and interdependent mountains and rivers. It is quite distinctive.Beijing Garden Expo Park uses green technology to carry out ecological restoration and construction on construction waste landfills. It is a large urban park integrating garden art, cultural landscape, ecological leisure and popular science education.The planning layout of the park is "one axis, two points, five gardens". "One axis" is the Garden Expo axis, which is the landscape axis that runs through the main exhibition area.The "two points" are Yongding Tower and Jinxiu Valley.The Yongding Tower is an antique tower in the Liao and Jin style, 69.7 meters high, and is the landmark building of the Garden Expo; the Jinxiu Valley is a model of "turning decay into magic" in the Garden Expo, turning a construction waste landfill pit of more than 20 hectares into a sunken flower valley full of flowers.The "five gardens" are the traditional exhibition garden, modern exhibition garden, creative exhibition garden, international exhibition garden and wetland exhibition garden, with a total of 69 exhibition gardens.It includes the three world garden systems of Oriental gardens, European gardens and Islamic gardens.Among them, Beijing Garden, Recalling Jiangnan Garden, Lingnan Garden, Min Garden, and Chongqing Garden respectively represent the Royal Garden, Jiangnan Garden, Lingnan Garden, Minnan Garden and Bayu Garden among Chinese classical gardens, and collectively display the art and charm of traditional gardening.In addition, Beijing Garden Expo has carefully created a number of characteristic plant gardens, introduced new and high-quality varieties, and is concentrated and large-scale.From March to May, you can see cherry blossoms, taste lilacs, peonies, and see the colorful tulip waterfall in the Eternal Blossom Valley.Starting from May, you can visit the park to enjoy the moon season. In July and August, the crape myrtle is in full bloom. In October and November, the mountains are covered with red leaves and the ginkgo avenue is golden.The Beijing Garden Expo has different scenery throughout the seasons and you will never tire of it.
description.zh_CN: 北京园博园为第九届中国国际园林博览会的举办地，位于北京西南部丰台区境内永定河畔绿色生态发展带一线，东临永定河新右堤，西至鹰山公园，南起梅市口路，北至莲石西路，依托永定河道，与卢沟桥遥相呼应，历史文化氛围浓郁，地形多变，山水相依，颇具特色。北京园博园利用绿色科技在建筑垃圾填埋场上进行生态修复建园，是一个集园林艺术、文化景观、生态休闲、科普教育于一体的大型城市公园。园区规划布局为“一轴、两点、五园”，“一轴”即园博轴，是贯穿主展区的景观轴线。“两点”即永定塔和锦绣谷。永定塔为辽金风格的仿古塔，高69.7米， 是园博园的标志性建筑；锦绣谷是园博园“化腐朽为神奇”的典范，将一个20多公顷的建筑垃圾填埋坑,打造成了花团锦簇的下沉式花谷。“五园”即传统展园、现代展园、创意展园、国际展园和湿地展园，共有展园69个。囊括了东方园林、欧式园林、伊斯兰式园林三大世界园林体系。其中，北京园、忆江南园、岭南园、闽园、重庆园分别代表了中国古典园林中的皇家园林、江南园林、岭南园林、闽南园林和巴渝园林，集中展示了传统造园的艺术和魅力。除此之外，北京园博园精心打造了多个特色植物花园，引进了新优品种，集中连片，颇具规模。3月至5月，可以看樱花、品丁香、观牡丹，还能看到锦绣谷里姹紫嫣红的郁金 香花瀑。5月起可以游园赏月季，7月、8月紫薇盛开，10月、11月满山红叶，银杏大道一片金黄。北京园博园四季景色各异、百看不厌。

description.en: Red Brick Art Museum is located in Cuigezhuang Township, Chaoyang District, Beijing. It is carefully built with traditional Chinese garden imagery. It is a contemporary art museum that embraces nature. It was founded by collectors Yan Shijie and Cao Mei. It was officially opened on May 23, 2014.Red Brick Art Museum hopes to promote the development of Chinese contemporary art through an orderly and high-quality series of exhibitions, combining collection, research, education, publishing and public activities, participate in international contemporary artist (project) exchanges, carry out research on outstanding issues and phenomena in the academic field, and become an important promoter of Chinese contemporary art.
description.zh_CN: 红砖美术馆地处北京市朝阳区崔各庄乡，采中国传统园林意象精心打造，是座怀拥自然的当代美术馆，由收藏家闫士杰和曹梅夫妇创立，2014年5月23日正式开馆。红砖美术馆期望通过有序且高品质的系列展览，结合收藏、 研究、教育、出版和公共活动，推动中国当代艺术的发展，参与国际当代艺术家（项目）交流，展开学术领域突出问题和现象研究，成为中国当代艺术的重要推动者。

description.en: The Capital Museum has seven floors, which are mainly divided into basic exhibition halls and special exhibition halls.The tour does not need to be limited to a few cultural relics. Instead, by visiting the First Expo, you can learn about the 3,000-year-old ancient city of Beijing and the 800-year-old urban development history of the capital, as well as the customs, customs, and living customs of old Beijing. These are the highlights of the First Expo.Basic display The basic display is the core display of the Capital Museum, including two parts: "The Ancient Capital of Beijing - History and Culture" and "Old Things in the Capital - Old Beijing Folklore Exhibition"."Ancient Capital Beijing - History and Culture" is located on the second floor of the square exhibition hall of the museum. It uses cultural relics and pictures to show the long road that Beijing developed from a northern frontier fortress to the capital of the dynasty to the capital of New China."Old Things in the Capital - Old Beijing Folklore Exhibition" is located on the fifth floor of the square exhibition hall. The exhibition uses the most characteristic element symbols of Beijing folk customs - hutongs and courtyards to reflect the theme of the exhibition.By displaying weddings, childbirth, festivals and other activities in Hutong neighborhoods, the living customs and various etiquette of old Beijingers in the late Qing Dynasty and the early Republic of China are shown.Thematic Exhibitions The Capital Museum also has various thematic displays in different exhibition halls, including: "Ancient Jade Art Exhibition", "Yandi Bronze Art Exhibition", "Beijing Ancient Buddhist Pagoda Cultural Relics Exhibition", etc. These exhibitions are supplements to Beijing's cultural display.The location of each thematic display is detailed on the sign in the museum lobby, and can also be checked on the official website: http://www.capitalmuseum.org.cn/zlxx/ztyscl.htm.The digital screening hall is located on the first floor of the circular exhibition hall. Currently, the high-definition digital film "Glorious Beijing" (more than ten minutes in length) is played every day, which interprets the glory of the ancient capital Beijing in a concise and clear way. There are seven shows every day (9:30, 10:30, 11:30, 13:10, 14:10, 15:10, 16:10), you can also refer to the official website: http://www.capitalmuseum.org.cn/zjsb/content/2006-01/23/content_59623.htm.The Capital Museum building itself is also very unique. Inside the building, there are sunken bamboo courtyards, simple Chinese-style archways and other scenic spots.The museum also has service facilities such as cafes, restaurants, and baggage delivery offices.It is free to make an appointment to visit the Capital Museum in advance, but you need to make an appointment in advance. You can make an appointment by phone or online. Personal appointment phone number: 010-63393339, appointment website: http://www.capitalmuseum.org.cn/zjsb/pwfw.htm. Each person cannot make more than five reservations at a time. Visitors can collect tickets at the north gate of the museum (with the reservation number or the valid ID used when making the reservation).
description.zh_CN: 首都博物馆共七层，主要分为基本陈列和专题陈列等展厅。游览时无须局限于个别几件文物，而是通过参观首博，了解到北京三千年古城、八百年都城的城市发展史，以及老北京的风土人情、生活习俗，这些是首博的亮点之处。基本陈列基本陈列是首都博物馆的核心陈列，包括《古都北京-历史文化篇》和《京城旧事-老北京民俗展》两部分。《古都北京-历史文化篇》位于博物馆方形展厅二层，使用文物和图片，展示了北京从一个北方边塞发展成王朝的都城，直至新中国首都的漫漫道路。《京城旧事-老北京民俗展》位于方形展厅的五层，该展览采用最具北京民俗特色的元素符号——胡同和四合院来反映展览的主题。通过展示胡同邻里的婚育、节庆等活动，表现清末民初老北京人的生活习俗和各种礼仪。专题陈列首都博物馆在不同的展厅还设有各种专题陈列，包括有：《古代玉器艺术精品展》、《燕地青铜艺术精品展》、《北京古代佛塔文物展》等等，这些展览陈列，是对北京文化展现的补充。各专题陈列的位置，在博物馆大厅指示牌中有详细的标明，也可以在官网查询：http://www.capitalmuseum.org.cn/zlxx/ztyscl.htm。数字放映厅位于圆形展厅一层的数字放映厅，目前每天都播放高清晰数字影片《辉煌的北京》（片长十几分钟），以简明清晰的手法演绎古都北京的辉煌，每天七场（9:30、10:30、11:30、13:10、14:10、15:10、16:10），也可参照官网：http://www.capitalmuseum.org.cn/zjsb/content/2006-01/23/content_59623.htm。首都博物馆建筑本身也非常有特色， 在建筑内部建有下沉式的竹林庭院，古朴的中式牌楼等景点小品。馆内还设有咖啡厅、餐厅、寄包处等服务设施。提前预约参观首都博物馆是免费的，但是需要事先预约，可以通过电话或者网络进行预约，个人预约电话：010-63393339，预约网址：http://www.capitalmuseum.org.cn/zjsb/pwfw.htm，每人每次预约不能超过五张，游客在博物馆北门领票（凭预约号或预约时使用的有效证件）参观。

description.en: Wild Duck Lake National Wetland Park is dominated by lake wetlands, with green reeds and a beautiful environment. There are also many cute wild ducks in the lake.You can come here on weekends to relax and enjoy the fresh air. You can also bring your children to feed the ducks, which is very interesting.Because it is far away from the urban area, there are not many tourists here, which makes people feel clean and comfortable. It is a good place for a half-day trip to the suburbs of Beijing.Tour Overview: Wild Duck Lake National Wetland Park is a scenic spot dominated by Wild Duck Lake.The gate of the scenic spot is located on the east side of the lake area. There is a parking lot for the scenic spot at the gate, which is very convenient.After entering the gate, you will first come to the Wetland Museum in the scenic area. With the theme of promoting wetlands, there are sand table simulated wetland ecological displays, specimen displays of bald cranes, golden eagles and other rare animals, as well as a dome movie and a Wild Duck Lake crafts store. You can take a stroll and have a brief visit.After passing the Wetland Museum, walk a few hundred meters forward to the lake, which is also the main tourist area of ​​the scenic spot.The reeds are floating here, the lake is rippling, and the scenery is very beautiful.Every summer, some lotus flowers bloom in the lake, and the scenery is endless and refreshing.Wild Duck Lake is famous for the many wild ducks in the lake. The ducks here are not afraid of people.Whenever tourists approach the lake, wild ducks come to the lake in groups to beg for food, which is very interesting.In addition to wild ducks, swans and other birds can often be seen in the lake, which is suitable for bringing children to watch and feed the animals.Cycling/Boating Wild Duck Lake is very large, with a circumference of about 5 kilometers. Walking is tiring. You can rent bicycles in the scenic area and ride slowly along the bicycle lanes around the lake.In addition to Wild Duck Lake, you can also see the beautiful Kangxi grassland next to it by bicycle.In addition, you can take a boat ride in the lake, but it will only be sailed when the weather is more suitable. It will be suspended in seasons such as early spring and late autumn or in rainy weather.There are several types of boats: hand slides, rocking oars, and battery boats. Taking a boat to watch animals on the lake and cross the reed marshes is also unique.If you don't cycle or take a boat, you can also walk on the wooden plank road in the middle of the lake area. There are tall reeds on both sides of the plank road, which makes people feel fresh and pleasant.In addition, there are vendors selling boiled duck eggs and other snacks in the scenic area, which you can buy and try.
description.zh_CN: 野鸭湖国家湿地公园以湖水湿地为主，芦苇青青，环境优美，湖中还有很多可爱的野鸭。周末可以前来放松踏青，呼吸新鲜空气，还能带小朋友来喂鸭子，十分有趣。因为远离市区，这里的游人也不会很多，让人觉得清净舒心，是京郊半日游的好去处。游玩概览野鸭湖国家湿地公园是以野鸭湖为主的景区。景区大门位于湖区东侧，大门处有景区停车场，十分方便。进入大门后，首先会来到景区内的湿地博物馆，这里以宣传湿地为主题，有沙盘模拟的湿地生态展示，白头鹤、金雕等珍稀动物的标本展示，还有球幕电影和野鸭湖工艺品店等，都可以逛逛，简单参观一下。经过湿地博物馆后，向前几百米便来到湖边，也是景区的主要游玩区域。这里芦苇飘荡，湖水微波荡漾，景色非常优美。每到夏天，湖中还有一些荷花盛开，风光无限，让人心旷神怡。野鸭湖是以湖中有很多野鸭而闻名，这里的鸭子并不怕人。每当游客靠近湖边，野鸭便成群结队来到湖边向游客讨食，十分有趣。除了野鸭之外，湖中还经常可以看到天鹅等鸟禽，适合带小朋友前来观看、喂养动物。骑行/乘船野鸭湖面积很大，绕行一周大约5公里，步行比较累，游玩时可以租用景区内的自行车，沿湖外围圈的自行车道慢慢骑行。除了野鸭湖外，骑自行车还可以看到旁边美丽的康西草原美景。另外，湖中可以乘船游玩，不过仅在气候比较合适的时候才会开船，初春和深秋等季节或阴雨天气便会停开。船有手滑、摇橹、电瓶船几种，乘船在湖上观看动物、穿越芦苇荡，也别有一番风味。如果不骑车或乘船，也可以步行在湖区中间的木制栈道上，栈道两侧都是高高的芦苇荡，让人觉得清新宜人。另外，景区内还有售卖煮鸭蛋等零食的小贩，可以买来尝尝。

suggested_duration.zh_CN: 建议游览时间：2小时 - 4小时

description.en: Nangong Wuzhou Botanical Park covers an area of ​​350 acres. It consists of a parrot garden in Beijing, an indoor parent-child theme amusement park, and a coconut grove fishing garden. It has a constant temperature all year round. Not only can you enjoy tropical plants, but it is also the largest parrot garden in the country and the only one in Beijing. It is a paradise for indoor birds.You can also take your baby to dance with colorful butterflies in the Greenhouse Theme Park, shuttle between the mini driving school and the Naughty Rainforest, enjoy the landscapes of various countries in the Famous Flower City, and taste Nangong's special delicacies in the Food of Light Jungle.
description.zh_CN: 南宫五洲植物乐园占地面积350亩，由北京一家鹦鹉园和一个室内亲子主题游乐园以及椰林垂钓园组成，四季恒温，不仅可以观赏  热带植物，还有全国较大、北京仅有的鹦鹉园，室内鸟的乐园。还可以带着宝贝在温室主题乐园里与彩蝶共舞，穿梭于迷你驾校和淘气雨林之间，在名花名城里观赏各国景观，到食光丛林品尝南宫特色美食。

description.en: The Jiuyan Tower Great Wall is located on the Flame Mountain at the junction of Yanqi Town in Huairou and Sihai Town in Yanqing. It is 1,141 meters above sea level. It is 155 meters higher than the Wangjing Tower in Simatai. It is the highest watchtower in the section of the Great Wall in Beijing.Because there are 9 arrow windows on each side of the watchtower, it is named after it and is one of the important passes of the Great Wall.At the same time, the Ming Dynasty Great Wall in Beijing is divided into two parts here, namely the inner Great Wall and the outer Great Wall.Climbing up the Jiuyan Tower, you can have a panoramic view of Jiankou, Beijing Jie and Mutianyu. There are nine observation holes on each side, so it is called Jiuyan Tower.
description.zh_CN: 九眼楼长城位于怀柔雁栖镇与延庆四海镇交界的火焰山上，海拔1141米，它比司马台的望京楼还要高出155米，是北京长城段中地势较高的一个敌楼。因敌楼每面有9个箭窗，故此得名，为长城重要关口之一。同时，北京的明长城在这里一分为二，即内长城和外长城。登上九眼楼，箭扣、北京结、慕田峪尽收眼底，四面各有九个瞭望的眼孔，所以称为九眼楼。

description.en: Houhai is an integral part of Shichahai, and Houhai Park is an area surrounding Houhai.There are rich green plants, wide water surfaces and rows of alleys. The former residences of celebrities are hidden among them. The numerous bars add to the popularity of the night here.The street structure of Houhai was formed in the Yuan Dynasty. It was the end point of water transportation at that time and was known as the "Beijing Ancient Seaport".Nowadays, Houhai is a leisurely place with water, mountain views, and weeping willows on the shore. The houses and residents on the shore, the surrounding scenic spots and the former residences of celebrities add to it the endless charm of Beijing flavor and history.
description.zh_CN: 后海是什刹海的一个组成部分，后海公园是围绕后海的一片区域。这里有丰富的绿植、宽阔的水面和一排排的胡同，名人故居隐匿其间，林立的酒吧为这里的夜晚增添了人气。后海的街巷结构形成于元代，这里当时是漕运的终点，被称为“北京古海港”。如今后海是一片有水而能观山，垂柳拂岸的闲散之地，岸上的民居与居民，周边的景点和名人故居更为它铺陈着京味和历史的无穷韵味。

suggested_season.zh_CN: 四季皆宜，夏季可赏荷花、泛舟湖上；春、秋季气候最是宜人；冬季后海冰面更是室外滑冰的好去处。

description.en: Badaling Wildlife World is adjacent to the Badaling Great Wall Scenic Area and is one of the famous zoos in Beijing.There are hundreds of species and tens of thousands of animals in the park, making it a great place to take children to see animals.You can drive around the entire zoo by car, making it easy to observe and feed the animals up close.Park Overview The main entrance of Badaling Wildlife World is located on the north side. At the end of the south side is an Ark Square. The square area has animal performance areas, viewing areas, etc., as well as a temple.There are two roads leading from the main entrance on the north side to the square on the south side. One road leads to the beast area (mainly carnivores), and the other road is the docile animal area (mainly herbivores). The animals in both areas are free-range. Visitors can observe the animals up close. In the docile animal area, you can also open the car window to feed.The tour route in the park is to first visit the beast area, then reach the square from here, visit the animal performance area and viewing area near the square, and then return from the docile animal area to visit and feed the docile animals along the way.The zoo can be entered by car, which is very convenient, but self-driving requires a certain fee.If you are a non-self-driving tourist, you need to take public transportation in the park. There are bus viewing buses on the road to the beast area, and you can also take the relatively open cage feeding car.After arriving at the square, you can walk back from the docile animal area or take a battery car back.The Beast Zone is the area where tourists first visit when entering the zoo. There are White Tiger Park, Wild Wolf Valley, Wild Boar Forest, Liger Park, Sun Bear Park and other parks. There are iron gates between each park to prevent animals from wandering around. The iron gates will automatically open when vehicles arrive in front of the gate.You can watch these animals along the way when driving or taking public transportation in the park. You can also feed the animals if you take the zoo's cage feeding car.It should be noted that if you drive through this area, you must close the windows and lock the doors (some animals will open the doors themselves) to prevent accidents.Ark Plaza Ark Plaza is mainly focused on performing arts and entertainment.There is an animal performance venue on the square. There are animal performances here every weekend and holidays. You can see bears riding bicycles, elephants dancing, etc. It is very suitable for bringing children to watch.There are also several animal viewing areas on the east side of the square. The animals here are kept in cages and can be fed.In some parks, you can hold baby animals and take photos with them.There is also a small Buddhist temple on the mountain behind the square. Those who are interested can visit and worship.On the way back to the docile animal area, you have to pass through the docile animal area. This area is dominated by herbivores, including sika deer, zebras, alpacas, camels, etc. You can get out of the car to feed them. Many animals will come to you for food, which is very interesting.You will pass a lake on the way, where you can watch egrets, swans and other animals.In addition, there are Peacock Gardens, Monkey Mountains, Panda Houses, etc. that can be visited. Some of the viewing gardens and feeding gardens may charge additional fees.
description.zh_CN: 八达岭野生动物世界紧邻八达岭长城景区，是北京有名的动物园之一。园内有上百种共数万只动物，是带着小朋友看动物的好地方。动物园内全程都可以开车自驾游览，方便近距离观察和喂养动物。园区概览八达岭野生动物世界的正门位于北侧，南侧尽头处是一座方舟广场，广场区域有动物表演区、观赏区等，还有一座寺院。从北侧的正门通向南侧广场共有两条路，一条途径猛兽（食肉动物为主）区，另一条路上是温顺动物（食草动物为主）区，两个区域的动物都是散养，游客可以近距离观察动物，在温顺动物区还可以打开车窗喂食。游览路线园内的游览路线为先观看猛兽区，从此路到达广场，游玩广场附近的动物表演区和观赏区等，然后从温顺动物区返回，一路参观和喂养温顺动物。动物园可以开车自驾进入，十分方便，但自驾需要收取一定费用。如果是非自驾游客则需乘坐园内公共交通，猛兽区的路上有大巴观赏车可以乘坐，也可以乘坐比较开放的铁笼喂养车。到达广场游玩后可以步行从温顺动物区返回，也可以乘坐电瓶车返回。猛兽区猛兽区是游客进入动物园先游玩的地带，这里有白虎园、野狼谷、野猪林、狮虎园、马来熊园等园区，每个园区之间有铁门阻隔，以防止动物走混，当车辆到门前时铁门会自动打开。开车或乘坐园内交通经过这里时可以沿途观看这些动物，若乘坐动物园的铁笼喂养车还可以喂食动物。需要注意的是，若自驾经过这个区域务必要将车窗关闭，车门加锁（有些动物会自己开车门），以防止意外发生。方舟广场方舟广场是以演艺娱乐为主。广场上有一个动物表演场，每到周末和节假日时这里会有动物表演，可以看到熊骑自行车、大象舞蹈等，非常适合带小朋友前来观看。广场东边还有几个动物观赏区，这里的动物都是养在笼子中的，可以进行喂食。有些园区内可以抱抱动物宝宝，还可以和小动物合影。在广场背后的山上，还有一座小的佛教寺院，有兴趣的可以前往参观朝拜。温顺动物区返回途中要经过的是温顺动物区，这里以食草动物为主，有梅花鹿、斑马、羊驼、骆驼等，可以下车喂养，好多动物会跑来要吃的，十分有趣。路上会经过一座湖泊，可以观赏白鹭、天鹅等动物。另外，还有孔雀园、猴山、熊猫馆等可以进入参观，其中个别的观赏园和喂养园可能会另外收取费用。

description.en: When you come to Zizhuyuan, you come to the kingdom of bamboo.There are bamboo buildings, bamboo pavilions, bamboo tables, bamboo chairs, and even large and small bridges decorated with bamboo in the park.This is also a good place to enjoy lotuses in summer in Beijing. It is very pleasant to go boating on the lotus pond, smell the fragrance of lotus flowers, and enjoy the cool breeze.The Bamboo Kingdom Park is dominated by bamboo scenery. The spectacular Dong Village Wind and Rain Bamboo Bridge allows visitors to personally experience the fun of Guizhou Dong people taking shelter from the rain on the bridge. The upper boat bridge is a large bamboo boat with bamboo canopy and bamboo windows.The Bamboo Market built with bamboos on the shore of the lake is crowded with people. People drink tea, taste bamboo meals, and buy various bamboo daily necessities and handicrafts here, which makes people feel the important position of bamboo in life.The park has many docks such as Lotus Ferry, East, South, and North. From mid-to-late March to the end of October every year, tourists can take a cruise here, go boating on the lake, and enjoy the scenery of the lake.In addition, there are small recreational facilities such as Huaguo Mountain Rafting, Battle in the Gulf of Aden, and Happy Island. Parents can take their children here to relax and have fun on weekends.
description.zh_CN: 来到紫竹院，便来到了竹子的王国。公园里有竹楼、竹亭、竹桌、竹椅，连大大小小的桥都用竹子装扮起来。这里还是北京夏日赏荷的好地方，泛舟荷花池上，闻着阵阵荷花清香，凉风习习，非常惬意。竹子的王国公园以竹景为主，壮观的侗寨风雨竹桥，可使游人亲身体会贵州侗族在桥上避雨休憩的趣味；上船桥则是一艘大竹船，竹篷竹窗。湖岸边用竹子搭建的竹市一条街上人头攒动，人们在这里饮茶，品尝竹膳，购买各种竹制日用品、工艺品，更让人感到竹在生活中的重要地位。玩乐设施公园有荷花渡、东、南、北等多个码头，每年的3月中下旬到10月底，游客可以到此乘坐游船，泛舟湖上，欣赏湖光水色。此外，园内还有花果山漂流、激战亚丁湾、开心欢乐岛等小型游乐设施，家长可以在周末带着孩子们来这里放松休闲。

description.en: Shuanglong Gorge is located in the green mountains and green valley 2.5 kilometers south of Huo Village, Zhaitang Town, Mentougou District.Its scenery can be summarized in sixteen words, "Ten miles of streams, hundreds of pools of waterfalls, thousands of acres of red apricots, and tens of thousands of hectares of forest." Shuanglong Gorge is picturesque all year round: from January to March, you can enjoy hundreds of ice falls on the Shili Glacier; from March to April, you can enjoy thousands of acres of apricot blossoms like the sea; from April to May, you can enjoy the ice waterfalls during the hiking season; from June to OctoberThere are ten miles of streams, hundreds of ponds waterfalls, thousands of acres of apricot orchards, thousands of forests, green mountains and green valleys, a paradise. From November to December, you can enjoy the red leaves on the mountains and the bright sun.Here, you can also experience the thrilling mountain climbing adventure in the primeval forest. Take a unique forest train to drive through the mountains, and the fragrance of flowers will be refreshing.Shenyi, like a fairyland.Take a small train into the scenic area and travel through streams and canyons. The scenery is very beautiful.If you come between December and May of the following year, you will also have the opportunity to enjoy the first ice waterfall. The ice waterfall as white as jade stretches across here, which is very spectacular.Be sure to bring your camera when you get here to capture this rare ice waterfall landscape.However, we emphasize that you must pay attention to safety. If you accidentally fall, it will be very troublesome.In addition to the ice waterfall, the scenic spot also has a unique forest train. When you get on the train, it is like going to Jiapigou, the "Smart Tiger Mountain", which you cannot experience in other places.
description.zh_CN: 双龙峡位于门头沟区斋堂镇火村南2.5公里的青山翠谷之中。其景色可以概括为十六个字，“十里溪流、百潭瀑布、千亩红杏、万顷林海。双龙峡一年四季景致如画：一月到三月份踏十里冰川，赏百挂冰瀑；三月到四月份赏千亩杏花潮如海；四月到五月份踏青时节赏冰瀑；六月到十月份十里溪流，百潭瀑布，千亩杏园，万倾林海，青山翠谷，世外桃源；十一月到十二份赏漫山红叶映日艳。在这里，您还可以体验惊险刺激的原始森林登山探险，乘坐独特的森林小火车行驶于山间，花香迎面而来令人心旷神怡，犹如仙境。乘小火车进入景区，一路穿行在溪流峡谷中，景色十分优美。如果在12月-次年5月之间前来，还有机会欣赏到第一冰瀑，洁白如玉的冰瀑横亘于此，十分壮观。能到这里一定要带上相机，留下这难得的冰瀑布景观。但是特别强调一定注意安全，如果不小心摔倒就十分麻烦了。景区除了冰瀑布外，这里还有独特的森林小火车，当你坐上小火车的时候，就如同到了“智取威虎山”夹皮沟，这是你在别的地方所体会不到的。

description.en: Zhuanta Hutong is located in Xisi, Xicheng District, Beijing, starting from Taipingqiao Street in the west and Xisi South Street in the east. This is one of the ancient hutongs in Beijing.Brick Pagoda Hutong appeared in operas of the Yuan Dynasty, so it is estimated to have a history of more than 700 years. It is called "Beijing's first hutong" and "the root of Beijing's hutongs" by the people.The name Brick Pagoda Hutong comes from an ancient blue brick pagoda standing in the hutong. This pagoda is the burial pagoda of the eminent monk Wansong during the Jin and Yuan Dynasties.Many famous people in modern times lived in this alley, such as Lu Xun, Zhang Henshui, Shao Lizi, Qi Yanming, etc.Hutong Nos. 42 and 44 are the former residences of Mr. Feng Yuxiang.Courtyard No. 84 in the Hutong is located in the former residence of Mr. Lu Xun, where "Blessing" was born.It's just that the former residences of these celebrities in the hutong have been demolished and have long lost their appearance. Only the Wansong Old Man's Tower at the entrance of the hutong still stands here.
description.zh_CN: 砖塔胡同位于北京市西城区西四，西起太平桥大街，东至西四南大街，这是北京古老的胡同之一。在元代的戏曲中出现过砖塔胡同，由此推算它已有700多年的历史，被百姓们称为“北京第一条胡同”、“北京胡同之根”。砖塔胡同这一名称，源于矗立在胡同中的一座青砖古塔，此塔是金元之际的高僧万松老人的葬骨塔。这条胡同曾住过许多近现代颇为有名的人，如鲁迅、张恨水、邵力子、齐燕铭等。胡同42号、44号为冯玉祥先生故居。胡同的84号院位于鲁迅先生故居，《祝福》即诞生于此。只是现在胡同里的这些名人故居都已拆除，早已没有了当年的模样，只有胡同口的万松老人塔依旧挺立于此。

description.en: Diaogou Primitive Forest Park is known as the back garden of the capital and is also known as the "natural oxygen bar".There are 70,000 acres of primary secondary forest here, with extremely lush plants. The Nanhou Ridge, with an altitude of more than 1,700 meters, is the highest peak in Huairou District.Rhododendrons are in full bloom all over the mountains and plains in spring, and red leaves are everywhere in autumn, creating a beautiful scenery.The entire scenic spot consists of three main viewing areas: Nanhou Ridge, Baizhang Cliff, and Glacier. The total area is 45 square kilometers, with more than 90% forest area, 677 plant species, more than 300 animal species, and 60 kilometers of green tourist trails.There are native virgin forests full of mystery, a sea of ​​clouds that is rare in Beijing, Phoenix Terrace that retains a large number of historical relics, summer glaciers in Beijing, a thousand acres of birch forest that can only be seen in Siberia, a thousand-foot-high cliff, eighteen winding roads that make driving people safe, Yishan Pine with magical legends, longevity springs, love springs, and pearl springs with miraculous effects. You can have an unobstructed view of the original natural scenery.
description.zh_CN: 喇叭沟原始森林公园有首都后花园之称，又有“天然大氧吧”之美誉。这里有原始次生林7万亩，植物极其茂盛，海拔1700多米高的南猴岭是怀柔区的最高峰。春天漫山遍野的杜鹃花盛放，秋天红叶遍布，景色优美。整个景区由南猴岭、百丈崖、冰川三个主要观赏区组成，总面积为45平方公里，森林面积在90％以上，植物种类有677种，动物300多种，绿色旅游步道达60公里。这里有充满了神秘色彩的原生原始森林，有北京地区罕见的云海，有保留了大量历史遗迹的凤凰台，有北京地区暑期冰川，有在西伯利亚才可看到的千亩白桦林，有壁立千仞的百丈崖，有令开车族有惊无险的十八盘道，有流传着神奇传说的壹善松，有具有奇功异效的长寿泉、爱泉、珍珠泉，原始自然风光一览无余。

suggested_season.zh_CN: 春可看满山杜鹃，夏可享受高海拔森林的清凉气候，秋可观色彩斑斓的秋叶。

description.en: Jingdong Grand Canyon is about 90 kilometers away from the center of Beijing. It is very convenient to travel from Beijing to and from Beijing in one day.The Grand Canyon has beautiful mountains and clear waters, and is surrounded by mountains and mountains. It is very suitable for relaxing, exercising and taking pictures.There are also glass plank roads, ropeways, slides and other entertainment projects in the scenic area, which are very exciting.The most suitable season for visiting Jingdong Grand Canyon is summer, when you come to escape the heat and enjoy the cool air. Other seasons are relatively cold.The general route for tourists to visit the scenic spot is to first walk around the canyon, which is about 3 kilometers. There are some landscapes in the canyon that can be visited.Then take the cableway at the end of the canyon to the top of Jingtai Mountain, watch the mountain scenery from the observation deck on the top of the mountain, and then take the slide or sightseeing car directly back to the ticket office of the scenic spot. You can also return to the cableway station and take the cableway and return from the original route in the canyon.However, the slide is a highlight of the scenic area, and most tourists choose to take the slide down the mountain.It takes about 3-4 hours to visit the entire scenic spot.There is a lake at the entrance of the scenic spot, where you can experience boating. The fee is about 30 yuan per person.Walking further inward, you enter the canyon. You need to climb up all the way. It is about 3 kilometers and can be completed in one hour.There are many trees in the canyon, as well as many pools and waterfalls. The environment is good and very cool, making it suitable for relaxing and exercising in the summer.There are also landscapes and entertainments such as Guanyin Temple, Reclining Buddha, and Chain Bridge in the valley, which you can visit one by one.It should be noted that entertainment items along the way are basically charged separately, so you should ask before visiting.At the end of the canyon is the place where you can take the cableway to the top of Jingtai Mountain.The terrain on Jingtai Mountain is flat and the view is very broad. There are several observation decks at the top of the mountain, where you can overlook the mountainous scenery in the distance, which is very spectacular.After visiting the top of Jingtai Mountain, you can go down the mountain. There are three options for going down the mountain: slide, sightseeing car and returning along the original route of the cable car.However, most tourists will choose to take the slide. The slide is four kilometers long. It takes about 15 minutes to slide from the top of the mountain to the bottom. It is very exciting and is also the highlight of the scenic spot.
description.zh_CN: 京东大峡谷距离北京市中心车程约90公里，从北京前来游玩可一日往返，十分方便。大峡谷内山清水秀，周围重峦叠嶂，非常适合放松锻炼和观景拍照。景区内还有玻璃栈道、索道、滑道等娱乐项目，非常刺激。京东大峡谷适合游玩的季节是夏季，适合前来避暑纳凉，其它季节则比较冷。游客游玩景区的一般路线为首先步行游玩峡谷，大约3公里左右，峡谷内有一些景观可以游览。然后在峡谷尽头乘坐索道到达井台山顶，在山顶的观景台观看山峦景色，然后乘坐滑道或观光车直接返回景区售票处，也可以回到索道站乘坐索道再从峡谷内原路返回。不过滑道是景区内的一个亮点，大部分游客都会选择乘坐滑道下山。游玩整个景区大约3-4小时左右。景区入口处有一块湖泊，可以在这里体验划船项目，收费大约是30元/人。再向内步行，便进入了峡谷，一路需要向上攀爬，大约3公里左右，1小时可以走完。峡谷内树木众多，还有多处潭水、瀑布，环境不错，而且十分凉快，适合夏季时来此放松锻炼。谷内还有观音寺、卧佛、铁索桥等景观和娱乐，可以一一游玩。需要注意的是，一路上的娱乐项目基本都是要另外收费的，游玩前要问清楚。峡谷的尽头处就是乘坐索道的地方，可以乘坐索道到达井台山顶。井台山上地势平坦，而且视野十分开阔，山顶处有几座观景台，可以眺望远处重峦叠嶂的山景，很是壮观。在井台山顶游玩之后就可以下山了，下山有滑道、观光车和沿缆车原路返回三种选择。不过一般游客都会选择乘坐滑道，滑道有四公里长，从山顶滑到下山大约15分钟左右，非常刺激，也是景区内的亮点项目。

suggested_duration.zh_CN: 建议游览时间：3小时 - 4小时

suggested_season.zh_CN: 景区四季景致不同，春时山花烂漫，百鸟鸣啭；夏时清风和煦，爽利畅怀；秋时万山红遍，层林尽染；冬时冰瀑高悬，银装素裹。是平谷地区少见的适宜四季游览的景区之一，也是北京地区少数适宜冬季观光的景区之一。

Among them, Dongling Stone Man, Xishan Lotus, Nantang North View, Beishan Green Cypress, Lingquan Ginkgo, Juren's House and Temple Ruins have been known as the "Eight Scenic Spots of Lingshui" since ancient times.There are three stone streets in front and behind Lingshui Village, with stacked houses clustered together, and ancient dwellings scattered in an orderly manner.The well-preserved "Juren Residence", named after Liu Maohuan and Liu Zengguang... Among them, Dongling Stone Man, Xishan Lotus, Nantang North View, Beishan Green Cypress, Lingquan Ginkgo, Juren's House and Temple Ruins have been known as the "Eight Scenic Spots of Lingshui" since ancient times.There are three stone streets in front and behind Lingshui Village, with stacked houses clustered together, and ancient dwellings scattered in an orderly manner.The "Juren Residences" that are now well preserved, including those of Liu Maohuan, Liu Zengguang, Tan Ruilong, Liu Mingfei and others, are elegant and exquisite, with blue bricks and gray tiles, gate towers, screen walls and stone steps. You can visit them one by one.The first stop of "Where Are We Going, Dad" was filmed in Lingshui Village. When you come here, you will also see the spider house where Jimmy Lin and Kimi lived, the goat house where Wang Yuelun and Wang Shiling lived, etc. It is a must-see for variety show fans.If you want to stay overnight in Lingshui Village, the farmhouse is of course essential.Lingshui and Cuandixia are not far from each other, and ordinary tourists can choose to visit one of the two.Those who are keen on ancient villages can also spend a few more days exploring this area.
