description.en: The Poly Art Museum is located at the southwest corner of the East Sishitiao Overpass in Beijing and is affiliated to the China Poly Group.It was established with the approval of the national and Beijing cultural relics authorities in December 1998, and was officially opened to the outside world in December 1999.An art museum established for a large state-owned enterprise in my country.The collection is mainly composed of more than 100 bronzes, as well as stone carvings, calligraphy and paintings, etc., and there are many rare art treasures in the world.The purpose is to carry forward the excellent traditional culture and art of the Chinese nation, rescue and protect precious Chinese cultural relics scattered overseas, and promote the construction of corporate culture.The collection display consists of two parts: bronzes and stone carvings. Most of the exhibits were rescued from overseas by the Poly Group. A considerable number of them are high-quality, unique or orphan items, with high historical and artistic value.
description.zh_CN: 保利艺术博物馆位于北京东四十条立交桥西南角，从属于中国保利集团。1998年12月经国家和北京市文物主管部门批准成立，1999年12月正式对外开放。为我国国有大型企业兴办的艺术类博物馆。馆藏以100余件青铜器为主，另有石刻、书画等，不乏有举世罕见的艺术珍品。以弘扬中华民族优秀传统文化艺术，抢救保护流散在海外的中国珍贵文物，推进企业文化建设为宗旨。馆藏展示由青铜器和石刻像两大部分组成，展品绝大多数为保利集团从海外抢救而来，相当部分属于精品、绝品或孤品，具有很高的历史和艺术价值。

description.en: Yinshan Tallinn is located in the north of Beijing, in the Ming Tombs Special Zone, about 60 kilometers away from the center of Beijing. It is a good place for tourists who like to visit ancient times.The scenic spot was originally the site of the famous Buddhist temple Fahua Zen Temple. Later, the temple was destroyed, leaving only the ancient pagodas in the temple. Among them, the five ancient pagodas from the Jin Dynasty on the square are relatively intact. The pagodas are simple and spectacular. Visiting here feels very simple and has a profound historical charm.The Yinshan Pagoda Forest Scenic Area is not large. The main tourist area is the square where the five ancient pagodas are located. You can take photos of the ancient pagodas here. The photos taken of the simple and spectacular scenes are very beautiful.Tallinn is backed by Silver Mountain. Since ancient times, this hill has been known as the "Iron Wall of Silver Mountain", which means that when it snows, the mountain is white and the cliff on one side is so steep that snow does not fall.Now when you come to the scenic spot, you can also climb the hills to see the steep mountain walls and the many small unknown ancient pagodas in the mountains. In addition, it is also very good to take a panoramic view of the five ancient pagodas on the mountain.
description.zh_CN: 银山塔林位于北京市北部，位于十三陵特区，距离北京市中心车程约为60公里左右，是一处爱好访古的游客们出游的好地方。景区原为有名的寺院法华禅寺所在地，后来寺院被毁，仅剩下寺内的古塔，其中以广场上的五座金代时期的古塔保存较为完整，塔身古朴壮观，来此参观感觉十分的古朴，历史韵味深厚。银山塔林景区面积不大，主要游玩区域就是五座古塔所在的广场处，这里可以为古塔摄影，古朴壮观的场面拍出的照片十分好看。塔林背靠银山，自古以来这座小山便有“银山铁壁”的说法，是指一到下雪时候山体洁白，而一侧的崖壁则陡峭的不会落雪。现在前来景区也可以爬小山游玩，观看陡峭的山壁，还有山间众多小的无名古塔，另外在山上拍摄五座古塔的俯瞰全景也十分不错。

suggested_duration.zh_CN: 建议游览时间：1小时

description.en: The Reclining Buddha Temple in Beijing is the "Shifang Puchue Temple".It is located at the southern foot of Shouniu Mountain in the north of Xishan Mountain and on the east side of Xiangshan Mountain, 30 kilometers away from the urban area.The temple was first built during the Zhenguan period of the Tang Dynasty (627-649). It was originally called Doushu Temple, also known as Shouan Temple.In the following dynasties, there were demolitions and constructions, and the name of the temple also changed with the changes of dynasties.After reconstruction in the 12th year of Emperor Yongzheng's reign in the Qing Dynasty, it was renamed Puchue Temple.Because in the Tang Dynasty, there was a reclining Buddha carved from sandalwood in the temple.Later, in the Yuan Dynasty, a huge bronze statue of Sakyamuni Nirvana was cast in the temple. Therefore, most people called this temple "Temple of the Reclining Buddha".The whole temple stands against the mountain, and its main buildings include the Tianwang Hall, the Third Buddha Hall and the Reclining Buddha Hall.The Hall of Reclining Buddha is the highlight of the whole temple.There is a huge bronze reclining Buddha in the temple.The Buddha is more than 5 meters long and weighs about 54 tons. He is lying sideways on a high couch with his legs stretched straight out, his left hand flat on his lap, and his right hand holding his head. His posture is natural. According to legend, this is the posture of Sakyamuni during his Nirvana in India.Twelve small clay Buddha statues stand next to it, showing the scene of Sakyamuni giving instructions to his disciples about his future affairs.This bronze statue was made in the Yuan Dynasty (14th century) and is a treasure of ancient Chinese religious art.
description.zh_CN: 北京卧佛寺即"十方普觉寺"。它位于西山北的寿牛山南麓、香山东侧，距市区30公里。该寺始建于唐贞观年间(627-649),原名兜率寺，又名寿安寺。以后历代有废有建，寺名也随朝代变易有所更改。清雍正十二年重修后改名为普觉寺。由于唐代寺内就有檀木雕成的卧佛。后来元代又在寺内铸造了一尊巨大的释迦牟尼涅磐铜像，因此，一般人都把这座寺院叫作"卧佛寺”。全寺倚山而立，主要建筑有天王殿、三世佛殿和卧佛殿。卧佛殿是全寺的精华。殿内有一尊巨大的铜卧佛。佛身长5米多，重约54吨，作卧睡状，侧身躺在高榻上，双腿直伸，左手平放在腿上，右手托着头，体态自然，相传这是释迦牟尼在印度涅盘时的姿势。旁边站着十二尊泥塑小佛像，表现释迦牟尼向他的弟子嘱咐后事的情景。这尊铜像为元代（14世纪）所造，是中国古代的宗教艺术珍品。
